scope: Local replay of the workshop module and replacement payment gate over reduced external host tables
remoteAccess: Read-only Sandbox migration history and schema metadata; no business records queried

cases: six historical migrations reconstruct the exact Sandbox workshop catalog
all seven module tables enable RLS and deny direct client writes
replacement preserves historical authorization, purchase and payment records
both public and private historical review entrypoints are retired for all client roles
historical request IDs and received-payment references cannot be spent again
review preserves schedule permissions and active account/studio restrictions
only authenticated staff with sales/schedule permissions in this studio can attest
pending/absent confirmation and unsupported currency/method are rejected
review records the real actor and database quote without reserving or selling
cross-studio students/offers, duplicate selection and required enrollment fail closed
both unsafe RPCs and direct evidence writes are inaccessible
authorized individual checkout persists one sale/payment and every reservation
review replays reordered sessions but rejects changed amount, mode, student or reference
checkout rejects missing evidence, another tenant and a changed checkout key
overpayment, inadequate deposit and a missing balance date are rejected
deposit checkout preserves balance/policy and replay survives subsequent payments
price/deposit changes after review cannot silently change the authorized purchase
a full session after review leaves authorization and all financial rows untouched
induced second-reservation failure rolls back sale, payment, reservations and consumption
evidence cannot be edited/deleted, including by its database owner
two independent connections consume the same authorization exactly once
two independent buyers of the last seat produce one sale and one unconsumed authorization
expired sessions and disabled payment methods cannot be attested

limitations: External host/Auth/Agenda/sales tables are reduced fixtures; not a full application migration replay.
Supabase JWT/PostgREST, SaaS entitlements and full financial triggers are not validated by this test.
Provider verification, UI integration and functional UAT remain pending.
